response.sql: WITH per_sex AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM per_sex) AS ana_ratio FROM per_sex

assumptions.assumption: Patients with NULL or empty SEX form their own group (NULL group is kept as a row), and it is included in the mean of per-sex ANA averages.
The mean of the per-sex average ANA values is the unweighted average of the per-sex averages, ignoring any sex group whose average ANA is NULL (all ANA missing).
Each examination row is counted once; since Patient.ID is a primary key, the inner join does not duplicate examinations.
